spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-DS-047] `StudioLayoutGrid` (schema id `hsk.studio.layout_grid@1`) is the alignment-guide overlay on a frame `StudioLayer`. It is a rendering/alignment aid distinct from `StudioAutoLayout` (which repositions children) and `StudioConstraint` (which resizes children); a frame MAY carry all three independently.
[STU-DS-047a] `StudioLayoutGrid` MUST support a uniform square grid with configurable cell size, color, and opacity, for icon and pixel-alignment work.

[STU-DS-047b] `StudioLayoutGrid` MUST support column and row guides with a count and one of two sizing modes: fixed size with left/center/right (columns) or top/center/bottom (rows) anchoring plus offset, or stretch mode with margin and gutter. Each guide set carries its own color and opacity.
[STU-DS-047c] A single frame MUST support multiple stacked `StudioLayoutGrid` overlays (e.g. columns + rows + uniform) that render simultaneously and toggle individually.
[STU-DS-047d] A `StudioLayoutGrid` configuration MAY be saved as a named grid style in `StudioStyleRegistry` ([STU-DS-033]) and reapplied across frames and documents like any other shared style.

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-DS-047] `StudioLayoutGrid` (schema id `hsk.studio.layout_grid@1`) is the alignment-guide overlay on a frame `StudioLayer`. It is a rendering/alignment aid distinct from `StudioAutoLayout` (which repositions children) and `StudioConstraint` (which resizes children); a frame MAY carry all three independently.
[STU-DS-047a] `StudioLayoutGrid` MUST support a uniform square grid with configurable cell size, color, and opacity, for icon and pixel-alignment work.

[STU-DS-047b] `StudioLayoutGrid` MUST support column and row guides with a count and one of two sizing modes: fixed size with left/center/right (columns) or top/center/bottom (rows) anchoring plus offset, or stretch mode with margin and gutter. Each guide set carries its own color and opacity.
[STU-DS-047c] A single frame MUST support multiple stacked `StudioLayoutGrid` overlays (e.g. columns + rows + uniform) that render simultaneously and toggle individually.
[STU-DS-047d] A `StudioLayoutGrid` configuration MAY be saved as a named grid style in `StudioStyleRegistry` ([STU-DS-033]) and reapplied across frames and documents like any other shared style.

scope_basis.heading: ### 10. Layout Grids (StudioLayoutGrid)
scope_basis.verbatim: [STU-DS-047] `StudioLayoutGrid` (schema id `hsk.studio.layout_grid@1`) is the alignment-guide overlay on a frame `StudioLayer`. It is a rendering/alignment aid distinct from `StudioAutoLayout` (which repositions children) and `StudioConstraint` (which resizes children); a frame MAY carry all three independently.

scope_basis.heading: ### 10. Layout Grids (StudioLayoutGrid)
scope_basis.verbatim: [STU-DS-047a] `StudioLayoutGrid` MUST support a uniform square grid with configurable cell size, color, and opacity, for icon and pixel-alignment work.

scope_basis.heading: ### 10. Layout Grids (StudioLayoutGrid)
scope_basis.verbatim: [STU-DS-047b] `StudioLayoutGrid` MUST support column and row guides with a count and one of two sizing modes: fixed size with left/center/right (columns) or top/center/bottom (rows) anchoring plus offset, or stretch mode with margin and gutter. Each guide set carries its own color and opacity.

scope_basis.heading: ### 10. Layout Grids (StudioLayoutGrid)
scope_basis.verbatim: [STU-DS-047c] A single frame MUST support multiple stacked `StudioLayoutGrid` overlays (e.g. columns + rows + uniform) that render simultaneously and toggle individually.

scope_basis.heading: ### 10. Layout Grids (StudioLayoutGrid)
scope_basis.verbatim: [STU-DS-047d] A `StudioLayoutGrid` configuration MAY be saved as a named grid style in `StudioStyleRegistry` ([STU-DS-033]) and reapplied across frames and documents like any other shared style.
